# Spar 0.6.10

This patch release adds durable, end-to-end agent observability. Spar now records
Pi provider spans, controller generations, tool inputs and outputs, retries,
errors, token/cache usage, latency, and eval scores through the authenticated
backend, with a server-side OpenTelemetry export path for Langfuse, Phoenix, or
an OTEL collector.

Trace events are written through the desktop's existing SQLite outbox, so a
network interruption delays delivery instead of losing or reordering a run.
Credential-shaped values are redacted before telemetry leaves the agent utility
process, and token-by-token deltas are folded into the completed generation to
avoid turning long traces into a local memory or disk-amplification problem.
